description: A waxy white-orange resin. Fifteen minutes, and you will be told something you cannot bring back.

effects.comeon_message: The smoke is foul and the room is already peeling.

events.text: [trip]Geometry arrives first, moving fast and with obvious intent.[/trip]
[trip]You break through. There is a space here and it has been arranged.[/trip]
[trip]Something is delighted to see you and is showing you things very quickly.[/trip]
[trip]You are being told something enormous. You will not be permitted to keep it.[/trip]
[trip]They see you off warmly, the way hosts do.[/trip]
[trip]The room reassembles. You have been gone twelve minutes and several years.[/trip]

effects.onset_message: The wall opens like a curtain drawn by professionals, and on the other side something turns and says: oh, it is you.

overdose.message: You go too far in and are shown too much at once. You come back shaking, intact, and unable to say a word about it.

effects.take_line: You load the {name} onto the screen and take it all in one long pull.

name: DMT
